page_title: TOU 2-1 NIC | Toulouse v Nice 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Stijn Spierings (Toulouse). Jeremie Pignard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+1' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Yann Gboho will be replaced by Cristian Casseres (Toulouse).
90+1' Substitution. Aron Donnum is replaced by Naatan Skytta (Toulouse).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Guillaume Restes was alert and made a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.
88' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but Guillaume Restes comes off his line to gather the ball.
86' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mohamed-Ali Cho, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
84' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Hicham Boudaoui and he is replaced by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Frank Magri (Toulouse) is coming onto the pitch as Thijs Dallinga cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Rough tackle by Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Great save! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Guillaume Restes.
80' Jeremie Pignard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) and blew his whistle.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Lotomba trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
77' Francesco Farioli prepares a substitution. Jeremie Boga is replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice).
76' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
75' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
73' Toulouse are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
69' 2 - 1 Yann Gboho (Toulouse) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball into the roof of the net in trademark fashion.
65' 1 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) was set free in the area by Warren Kamanzi and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 1:1.
65' Evann Guessand (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
64' Substitution. Melvin Bard walks off the pitch and Romain Perraud (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
64' Here is a change. Terem Moffi is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
63' Jeremie Boga (Nice) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes earns his money with a fine reflex save.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) for Kevin Keben.
60' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Toulouse.

59' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top right corner. His long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
59' The referee points to the corner flag and Toulouse will take a corner.
58' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
58' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
56' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
53' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Nice win a corner.
50' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Terem Moffi (Nice) for a tough tackle.
48' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
47' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Nice are awarded a mid-range free kick.
45+1' Logan Costa (Toulouse) sees a yellow card from Jeremie Pignard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
43' Marcin Bulka dives like superman to thwart a rebound from Kevin Keben (Toulouse) which would probably have ended up in the left side of the goal.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.

40' Melvin Bard (Nice) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Guillaume Restes to dive and make a save. Nice force a corner. They send men into the box.
39' Terem Moffi (Nice) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
38' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Nice take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
38' Evann Guessand (Nice) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.

37' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Marcin Bulka inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
34' The game is interrupted now, Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
29' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for an infringement.

28' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
26' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Terem Moffi (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
22' The game is interrupted as Terem Moffi (Nice) is flagged offside.
20' Melvin Bard (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
19' Dante (Nice) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
16' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
13' Terem Moffi (Nice) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.

11' Yann Gboho releases Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) with a pass, he composes himself and shoots from mid-range but the ball curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Terem Moffi (Nice) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
7' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
3' The foul by Khephren Thuram (Nice) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jeremie Pignard.
2' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Toulouse will take the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
